test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of interest (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P x R x T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (₹2000 x 7% x 6 years) / 100

⇒ SI = (₹2000 x 7 x 6) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹840

**The simple interest is ₹840.**
